subject.title: fix(core): make indexed access explicit across remaining src (NUIA phase 3b)

question: Should this protected broad phase be repaired in place after all five optional-state regressions are fixed and proven, or split into smaller owner-boundary PRs?
rationale: The defects are mechanically repairable, but the `maintainer` label protects a 239-file cross-core phase and repository policy requires explicit owner handling plus representative runtime proof.

options.title: Repair in place
options.body: Keep the phase intact, restore all five established optional states, add focused coverage, and require final-head runtime proof before approval.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Separate setup/hooks, gateway usage, and remaining mechanical cleanup if maintainers cannot confidently audit the broad branch as one unit.

recommendation.title: Repair in place
recommendation.body: Keep the phase intact, restore all five established optional states, add focused coverage, and require final-head runtime proof before approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged history connects this person to the staged rollout and the central setup, hooks, and plugin SDK surfaces, making them the best available owner for the scope decision.
